topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe it? I was just mindlessly wandering through this pawn shop, killing some time, and there it was, sitting all shiny and small in this glass case, like it was waiting just for me. I knew it from the old photos, the ones with grandma and grandpa beaming, her hand held up high. It was a shock, but the best kind! I practically skipped to the counter, my heart going a million miles an hour. When I told them I wanted it, there was no doubt in my mind. It’s like a piece of her, you know? A sweet, unexpected treasure that’s been waiting to come home.
